title: Chart Settings
content:
TradingView's chart settings allow traders to personalize their chart layouts. To access these settings, click the gear icon in the chart's top-right corner or right-click in the chart and select "Settings" to open a pop-up window. Here, you can adjust:
Symbol: Change the candlestick and price line display (e.g. High and Low price)
Status Line: Adjust the ticker and indicator status lines
Scales: Change the chart scales and add price labels (e.g. Symbol name, Indicator name, etc.)
Canvas: Modify the chart's appearance (e.g. Background color, scale text size/color, margins, etc.)
